newsitem.title: UK: Grand Met climbs on pub news, press tips.
newsitem.headline: Grand Met climbs on pub news, press tips.

text.p: Shares in drinks, food and retail group Grand Metropolitan Plc rose on Monday amid positive weekend press comment and on talk that its jointly owned Inntrepreneur pub group may soon be released from a pledge on competition.
The shares were 5p higher at 469-1/2p by 0935 GMT.
The Financial Times (FT) said on Monday that Inntrepreneur, a pub chain owned by Grand Met and Foster's, could be allowed to continue as sole seller of beer to its pubs.
Inntrepreneur had previously threatened to sell its pubs should the pledge, made in 1991, not be lifted.
Separately, the Sunday Times and Sunday Telegraph gave upbeat comments on Grand Met shares in anticipation of the group's final results on Thursday.
Analysts expect annual profits of between 948-999 million stg, up from 920 million a year earlier.
The Sunday Times said the group was clearly more focused and that the shares still had further to climb.
